_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes:

The same guard covers final firmware push, live results, PID Apply, known-good snapshots, archive restore/trust and cross-scan comparisons. Historical accepted profiles remain recoverable and raw evidence stays retained.

Default533/Valinor530 focused checks passed, final47 each, delivery regressions218/221, standard helper/parser/worker scripts and both layout/smoke checks passed. All26 frozen MID primary fits replay exactly; Arduino delivery20242/20242 and9535/9535=100%, nativeNI no gaps/backtracks. Separate verified restoration reconciles the paused-PRESSX cleanup attempt.

This release changes host acceptance only. Firmware, controller gains, timing, actuator limits and calibration remain unchanged. Startup inflation must accommodate both very large cuffs near the10second fill goal and the stronger wrist response; startup deflation, physical pulse preservation, achieved quiet SmartConstMAP+5 and all-band SysID qualification remain under investigation. No experimental tuning is adopted.
